project_type: React 18 + TypeScript 5.7 + Vite 6 single-page app (one frontend package, no monorepo). Vite dev server proxies /api to the FastAPI backend on :8000.
build_system: npm + Vite. Build script `tsc -b && vite build` (package.json "build"). tsconfig.json is strict:true, noUnusedLocals:false, noUnusedParameters:false. A `@/* -> ./src/*` path alias exists in tsconfig but the ENTIRE codebase uses relative imports (../../...) — keep using relative imports.
test_framework: NONE. No test runner is configured (no vitest/jest, no "test" script in package.json). Verification is the TypeScript/Vite build only.

test_command: cd "d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend" && npm run build  (no unit tests exist; the build IS the verification)
verification_instructions: 1. cd "d:\SIH NEW PROJECT\frontend". 2. Run `npm run build`. 3. It must exit 0 with zero TypeScript errors and emit dist/. Fix all tsc errors (mostly null-safety from strict mode, enum comparisons, BadgeColor values, Select string values) and re-run until clean.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is produced by `vite build` but is NOT checked in (build artifact). No generated source files need committing. Command to produce: `npm run build`.

The dev server (:5173) and backend (:8000) do NOT need to be running to run `npm run build` (build is static). apiClient baseURL is absolute http://localhost:8000/api/v1.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING.md found in the frontend. Conventions observed: default-export page components (lazy-loaded in App.tsx), relative imports, Tailwind utility classes matching the existing UI components, react-query v5 object-form API, DataNote banner + PageHeader on every page.
key_patterns: react-query v5 object form: useQuery({queryKey,queryFn}) and useMutation({mutationFn,onSuccess:()=>queryClient.invalidateQueries({queryKey}),onError}). Mutations use `mutation.isPending` for button loading. PageHeader({title,breadcrumbs,actions}) for page titles (last breadcrumb is current page, no href). DataNote banner at top of pages. Form components Input/Textarea/Select accept RHF register() output via ...rest. Modal({isOpen,onClose,title,children,size}). SelectOption.value is ALWAYS string (convert numeric ids with String()/Number()). BadgeColor union: gray|blue|indigo|yellow|orange|purple|green|red|cyan only. date-fns format() guarded: v ? format(new Date(v),'...') : '—'. Enum comparisons via imported enum members (CoordinationStatus.draft, AccountStatus.pending_approval). PaginatedResponse<T> -> use .items (and .total); listBureaus()/listImports() return arrays directly.
